summary: iter-348 full regression on 4 features from user Message 557 (End Implant Treatment button, mandatory replacement placement date, home Analytics quick-link across all clinical roles + new metrics). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (validation errors, end-treatment happy path, replacement placement_date required, analytics shape+scope for admin/student/supervisor, CSV RBAC). Frontend: Home quick-link visibility verified for implant_incharge (visible, navigates to analytics), student (visible, subtitle 'Your cases · read-only', CSV export hidden), nurse (hidden on dashboard AND direct URL shows 'Access denied — Nurses cannot access implant survival analytics'). Survival Review UI: red 'End Implant Treatment' button toggles correctly — 'Was it replaced?' disappears and decision-maker dropdown + reason textarea appear; Continue-to-Phase-3 button stays aria-disabled=true until both are filled, then becomes enabled (aria-disabled=null). Replacement path: 'Placement date *' label + native HTML5 date input (type='date') present; Continue button remains aria-disabled=true until placement_date + all other required fields (system, diameter, length, procedure_type) are supplied.
